`speed(x)` in `app/core.py` now returns `{"value": x * 2.5, "unit": "kmh"}`. Every caller in the repo still gets the same numbers it got before.

Every module that imports `speed` uses its result as a number (arithmetic, comparison, `max`, `sum`, `round`), so I updated each caller to read `["value"]
